title: Core Glossary: Workbenches — Signature Edition — Signature Method
description: Core Glossary: Workbenches — Signature Edition — Signature Method: the working vocabulary of Workbenches — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. The Signature edition: the JAH system's original reference on Workbenches. Workbenches anchor shops: heavy tops resist force, vises hold, assembly tables stay flat. Build once, build heavy.
definition: Core Glossary: Workbenches — Signature Edition — Signature Method — the working vocabulary of Workbenches — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Workbench: The heavy table anchoring hand and machine work.
Vise: The clamp holding work to the bench or machine.
Dust collection: Ducted vacuum keeping airborne dust down at machines.
French cleat: Angled wall strips holding modular tool hangers.
Sawhorse: The portable trestle supporting long workpieces.
Pegboard: Perforated board holding tools on hooks.
Layout: Marking cut lines and positions before working.
Feed rate: How fast material moves through a machine.
Lockout: Locking energy sources off during maintenance.
PPE: Personal protective equipment: glasses, hearing, dust, gloves.
